about: Shapes retention, and chooses what becomes a Short.

provides.briefing: Engineer retention: hook, open loops, re-hooks, ending. Preserve every claim id — you may reword, never unsource.

Choose this Short's window from the beat plan's hook markers and write its own hook and CTA. Resolve the window with scripts/cut.py against the renderer's published timeline -- never by adding up the narration clips, which still carry their recorded silence and run long.
